items.name: Rocky outlined board 6 x 10
items.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign the supplied rocky board background into a clean CARTOON game board with explicit tile lines and outer border. Image1 is the rocky-floor edit target; image2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for the game's smooth dark plum contours and simple cel-shaded stone colors. Do not copy the dungeon gate or any object from image2. The current mottled realistic stone should become much simpler: very light warm-gray stone with a faint lavender cast, mostly solid color, only a handful of broad muted flat shadow patches and tiny flat chip marks. No photographic grain or noisy mottling. All tile interiors must be quiet and low-contrast so small40px creatures remain readable. Direct orthographic overhead view, no perspective, no depth/extrusion. No creatures, rocks, boulders, holes, obstacles, props, writing, UI controls, labels, numbers or gameplay targeting boxes. Use clean consistent rounded dark-plum cartoon outlines, with a stronger outer contour and clear finer interior tile lines. No loose debris outside the board. Full-bleed artwork, no white margin or exterior scene. Keep the whole rectangular board flush to all four image edges, with a subtly rounded outer contour but no padding. Grid cells are perfect equal squares; absolutely no staggered pavers, irregular tiles or additional seams.
CANVAS AND EXACT GRID: portrait 1200x2000 pixels. EXACTLY 6 columns and 10 rows, 60 equal square cells. Cell pitch is200px, measured from canvas edges: vertical interior grid lines at x=200,400,600,800,1000; horizontal lines at y=200,400,600,800,1000,1200,1400,1600,1800. No margin around the grid. Interior lines are muted dark plum-gray #776a73, about5px thick at target resolution. The outer contour is deep plum #36212d, about12px thick drawn inside canvas edges. REPLACE the horizontal grid line at y=1200 with a clean purple #6050b8 divider about10px thick spanning the entire board. This leaves 6 full rows above the purple line and 4 rows below it. All rows retain exactly the same height; no extra divider row, band, gap or padding. The purple divider is the only saturated feature. Output only this single board.
